title: CIViC nightly clinical evidence summary (all cancers)
description: Public, community-curated molecular profile and clinical evidence summary table. Export includes evidence status, linked source, disease ontology, and evidence identifiers.
unit_of_observation: One CIViC evidence item per row, not one patient or independent clinical trial
cohort_definition: All evidence summary records in the nightly CIViC export; disease filters and acceptance status must be applied explicitly by consumers. This is not a patient cohort.

access.notes: Nightly bulk TSV is publicly downloadable without authentication; content changes as CIViC editors update records.

reuse.notes: CIViC explicitly dedicates published data to the public domain under CC0; retain source/version citations for scientific provenance.

release.label: nightly latest, mutable (archive exact bytes by SHA-256)

research_context.note: The EGFR/LUAD pilot filtered this pan-cancer CIViC evidence export to accepted EGFR-profile evidence items with strict LUAD disease labeling; the export as a whole is not EGFR/LUAD-specific.
